response_json.request: Hi , Create a slot pattern across the plastic part surface on both the top and bottom sides.

actions.target: Top-side surface of the plastic part
actions.relational_constraint: The slot pattern must be located on and extend across the top-side surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: The semantic-orientation mapping identifies CAD +Y as the top with 0.82 confidence. The corresponding plastic-like perimeter housing surface is the upper rail wall, F002 / FACE 46, on SOLID 0. The intended slot length, width, end radius, count, spacing, pattern margins, orientation, and cut depth are not specified. The pattern must avoid the upper service cap F012 / FACE 798, the positive-Y corner mounting component F011 / FACE 796, rail transitions, and sealing or coolant-containing regions.
steps: Operate only on the principal radiator-frame body, SOLID 0, while preserving the disconnected fan blades, coolant fittings, mounting components, and service-cap solids.

Locate the human-semantic top from part.semantic_orientation: the +Y view is mapped to top with inferred status and 0.82 confidence. Select R01, feature F002, and the extreme positive-Y planar upper perimeter rail wall FACE 46 at approximately CAD y=174.851756 mm.

Confirm FACE 46 by its planar geometry, extreme positive-Y position, and long span along CAD Z. Use these geometric criteria in addition to the CadQuery face index so that selection remains robust if earlier topology changes renumber faces.
Create a sketch directly on FACE 46, equivalent to an XZ-oriented sketch plane with the cut direction pointing inward along negative CAD Y.

Project or reference the usable boundaries of FACE 46. Establish keep-out regions around the centered upper service cap F012 / FACE 798, the positive-Y positive-Z mounting pad F011 / FACE 796, end transitions, and a structural edge margin around the perimeter rail.

Define a fully constrained straight-slot profile using a centerline and equal-radius semicircular ends. Expose slot length, slot width, end radius, cut depth, member count, pitch, and edge clearance as parameters because the request does not provide dimensions.

Orient the seed slot consistently within the rail width and place it inside a clear region of FACE 46. Pattern the seed along the long left-right direction of the assembly, CAD Z, so the repeated slots extend across the available top rail surface rather than into the service-cap or mounting-pad keep-out zones.

If a single linear pattern cannot cross the centered service-cap exclusion without interference, split the pattern into positive-Z and negative-Z groups using the same pitch and slot dimensions, leaving a centered clearance around F012 / FACE 798.

Cut the slot profiles inward from FACE 46 into F002. Use a controlled blind groove depth unless a through-slot or through-all ventilation cut is explicitly confirmed; do not cut into the radiator core, coolant passage, or adjacent disconnected components.
Apply any requested edge treatment only after the cut pattern is complete. If no fillet or chamfer is specified, retain the generated slot edges without adding an inferred treatment.
Validate that every slot intersects only SOLID 0 and F002, that minimum wall thickness and edge margins are maintained, and that F012 / FACE 798 and F011 / FACE 796 remain unchanged.

Recompute the assembly and verify the pattern from the +Y, +X, -X, and isometric views. Confirm that all slots are visible on the top rail, evenly distributed across the usable span, and do not interfere with the fans, grille, fittings, mounting interfaces, or service cap.

actions.target: Bottom-side surface of the plastic part
actions.relational_constraint: The slot pattern must be located on and extend across the bottom-side surface.
actions.unresolved_reference: The semantic-orientation mapping identifies CAD -Y as the bottom with 0.82 confidence. The corresponding plastic-like perimeter housing surface is the lower rail wall, F002 / FACE 22, on SOLID 0. The intended slot length, width, end radius, count, spacing, pattern margins, orientation, and cut depth are not specified. The pattern must avoid the negative-Y corner mounting component F013 / FACE 797, rail transitions, and any coolant-containing or structurally critical regions.
steps: Continue modifying only the principal radiator-frame body, SOLID 0, and preserve all disconnected assembly solids.

Locate the human-semantic bottom from part.semantic_orientation: the -Y view is mapped to bottom with inferred status and 0.82 confidence. Select R01, feature F002, and the extreme negative-Y planar lower perimeter rail wall FACE 22 at approximately CAD y=-171.45 mm.

Confirm FACE 22 by its planar geometry, extreme negative-Y location, and long span along CAD Z. Combine the exact FACE 22 index with geometric selection criteria to reduce sensitivity to topology renumbering.
Create a sketch on FACE 22, equivalent to an XZ-oriented sketch plane with the material-removal direction pointing inward along positive CAD Y.

Project or reference the usable lower-rail boundaries and establish keep-out clearances around the negative-Y negative-Z mounting pad F013 / FACE 797, end blends, external corners, and structural edge margins.
Reuse the same parameterized slot definition established for the top-side pattern so that the top and bottom slot dimensions, end radii, pitch, and general visual alignment remain consistent.

Place the bottom seed slot within the clear portion of FACE 22 and create a linear pattern along CAD Z, the long left-right direction of the rail. Distribute the members across the usable bottom surface while suppressing or omitting any member that would intersect F013 / FACE 797 or a perimeter transition.

Where practical, align the bottom pattern stations with the top pattern stations by projection or shared CAD-Z coordinates. Because the upper and lower rails have different reported extents and different attached features, allow the bottom member count or end offsets to vary if required to preserve clearances.

Cut the patterned slot profiles inward from FACE 22 into F002. Use the same controlled blind depth as the top pattern unless a through-all requirement is supplied; do not allow the cuts to enter the radiator core or inferred coolant volume.
Do not modify the lower mounting pad F013 / FACE 797 or any coolant fitting. Keep each slot entirely within the planar support region of FACE 22 and maintain adequate residual rail thickness.
Apply no additional fillet or chamfer unless a slot-edge treatment is later specified. If an edge treatment is added, use the same value on both top and bottom patterns.

Validate the resulting body for self-intersections, open shells, and accidental cuts into other solids. The source STEP validity check is already false, so separately verify that the new Boolean operation does not worsen the topology of SOLID 0.

Inspect the result from the -Y, +X, -X, and isometric views. Confirm that the bottom slots extend evenly across the available lower rail, correspond visually with the top pattern, and preserve the radiator frame, fans, grilles, ports, corner mounts, and service interfaces.
